stemMd: Which depot has the highest return rate?

options.label: D
options.textMd: All categories have the same rate

explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Hill: 88/100=88%; Market: 120/150=80%; River: 225/250=90%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 90%.

distractorRationale.a: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 88%, 80%, 90%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.c: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 88%, 80%, 90%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
distractorRationale.d: The ratios differ; equal rates cannot be inferred from the raw totals.
